text: Which genes with enhanced salivary gland expression are enhanced in salivary duct cells (single-cell) and have no detectable mRNA in liver?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Salivary gland / Tissue enhanced AND Cell type category (scRNA): Salivary duct cells / Cell type enhanced AND Tissue category (RNA): Liver / Not detected
understanding: Identify genes with enhanced RNA expression in salivary gland tissue, enhanced RNA expression specifically in salivary duct cells based on single-cell RNA-seq, and no detectable mRNA expression in liver.

trail.why: The user specifically requests genes with enhanced salivary gland expression, which corresponds to selecting 'salivary gland' at Level 1 and 'Tissue enhanced' at Level 2.
The requirement specifically specifies genes enhanced in salivary duct cells, matching the 'Salivary duct cells' cell type and the 'Cell type enhanced' category.
Selecting 'liver' at Level 1 combined with 'Not detected' at Level 2 precisely identifies genes with mRNA levels below the detection threshold in liver tissue.
